candidate.price: The Data Transparency bulk datasets are publicly downloadable; separate database information is also offered for sale by contract.

observed_evidence: Separate Corporation and LLC master, name, agent, annual-report, assumed/old-name, stock/other, manager, and series files are listed with downloadable documentation; person and agent tables require exclusion.
The individual database reports active/inactive status, which is registry standing rather than proof of current business operation.

Business Services oversees registered corporations, nonprofits, LLCs, LPs, and LLPs, while the published transparency bulk lists specifically identify Corporation and LLC datasets and therefore do not prove complete operating-business coverage.
The search database includes registered-office addresses, but the reviewed bulk landing page does not itself prove an eligible organization-controlled address or ZIP contract.
The portal publishes bulk files but the reviewed landing page does not state snapshot timestamps, refresh cadence, deletion/replay semantics, manifests, or checksums.
assessment_snapshot.strongest_bounded_next_action: Review the official file documentation and terms offline for a person-free, organization-address projection and refresh/redistribution contract if separately authorized. candidate.publisher: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs, Business Registration Division
candidate.price: The service is described as purchasing custom lists, but current pricing was not established on the reviewed official DCCA pages.

observed_evidence: Historical official inventory describes business lists and addresses/officers/trade names/marks; the current page does not publish a machine schema, field dictionary, or person-free option.
The registry supports good-standing checks and annual reports for active entities, but registration standing is not proof that an establishment currently operates.
BREG maintains registrations across many entity types, but not all businesses must register; list-builder scope during the 2026 portal transition is not established as a complete statewide extract.
Business lists may include addresses, but ZIP presence and address roles are not contractually defined; officer, member, manager, and agent addresses require exclusion.

A historical state inventory described weekly bulk data, but current BREG pages announce a July 2026 system transition; current cadence, continuity, deletions, replay, manifest, and checksums are unresolved.
assessment_snapshot.strongest_bounded_next_action: Wait for migration stabilization, then obtain current unsigned list/bulk terms, person-free schema, completeness, cadence, automation, and redistribution rights if authorized. Do not purchase, sign up, contact, scrape, download, or execute production from this assessment.
